description: Manual-book level attribution (aggregates only; no signal row, price or note). manual_book = trade_stream 'manual' (the study's query); with_algo_armed = 'manual' plus 'algo_manual' (the signals the owner armed for the algo, which are the only ones that ever filled).

manual_book.description: Manual-book level attribution: which structures the owner's entries and stops sit on and whether the analysis engine publishes a matching candidate. Aggregates only. 'explains' = the proximal entry is inside the structure or within 0.25 M5 ATR of it; distances are to the nearest structure of the family on that timeframe, in M5 ATR at the state bar.
